title: Visible offline handling with no silent data loss
iWant: the application to tell me what it can and cannot do right now
soThat: a network drop never costs me work I already did

acceptanceCriteria.description: When connectivity is lost, the shell banner names the condition within a short detection window, without blocking interaction with already-loaded content.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the offline banner renders and existing content stays usable

acceptanceCriteria.description: Failed reads render the error state with a retry affordance; retry succeeds once connectivity returns.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the data loads and the error state clears

acceptanceCriteria.description: A write attempted offline is either queued with visible pending status or refused with an explanation; the entered payload remains in the form in both cases.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the write cannot reach the server
acceptanceCriteria.then: queued-or-refused is explicit and the input is intact

acceptanceCriteria.description: Queued writes replay on reconnect in order; replay outcomes are surfaced per write, and a replay failure re-presents the payload for user action.
acceptanceCriteria.given: queued writes and a restored connection
acceptanceCriteria.then: successes confirm, failures return to the user with data intact

acceptanceCriteria.description: On reconnect the banner clears and stale views revalidate per application-spa-US-1120 without requiring a reload.
acceptanceCriteria.then: visible data refreshes in the background

acceptanceCriteria.description: No code path discards user-entered data on a network failure; this holds for every mutating surface in the application.
acceptanceCriteria.when: network failure is injected at submit
acceptanceCriteria.then: the entered data survives on screen or in the queue in every case
